title: Cup
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个杯子，里面装了水，如果我问你：”这是什么？”
你会回答什么？我把水倒掉后，再问你相同的问题，你又会回答什么？当一个杯子装满水的时候，人们可能会说：”这是水。”当一个杯子装满牛奶的时候，人们可能会说：”这是牛奶。”只有杯子里什么东西也没有时，人们才会说：”看，这是一个杯子。”
其实我们也是一样，当我们心中装满了财富、成见、权势的时候，就不再是我们自己了。人往往热衷拥有很多，但往往很难真正拥有自己。
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個杯子，裡面裝了水，如果我問你：”這是什麼？”
你會回答什麼？我把水倒掉後，再問你相同的問題，你又會回答什麼？當一個杯子裝滿水的時候，人們可能會說：”這是水。”當一個杯子裝滿牛奶的時候，人們可能會說：”這是牛奶。”只有杯子裡什麼東西也沒有時，人們才會說：”看，這是一個杯子。”
其實我們也是一樣，當我們心中裝滿了財富、成見、權勢的時候，就不再是我們自己了。人往往熱衷擁有很多，但往往很難真正擁有自己。
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī gè bēi zi， lǐ miàn zhuāng le shuǐ， rú guǒ wǒ wèn nǐ：” zhè shì shén me？”

nǐ huì huí dá shén me？ wǒ bǎ shuǐ dào diào hòu， zài wèn nǐ xiāng tóng de wèn tí， nǐ yòu huì huí dá shén me？ dāng yī gè bēi zi zhuāng mǎn shuǐ de shí hou， rén men kě néng huì shuō：” zhè shì shuǐ。” dāng yī gè bēi zi zhuāng mǎn niú nǎi de shí hou， rén men kě néng huì shuō：” zhè shì niú nǎi。” zhǐ yǒu bēi zi lǐ shén me dōng xi yě méi yǒu shí， rén men cái huì shuō：” kàn， zhè shì yī gè bēi zi。”

qí shí wǒ men yě shì yī yàng， dāng wǒ men xīn zhōng zhuāng mǎn le cái fù、 chéng jiàn、 quán shì de shí hou， jiù bù zài shì wǒ men zì jǐ le。 rén wǎng wǎng rè zhōng yōng yǒu hěn duō， dàn wǎng wǎng hěn nán zhēn zhèng yōng yǒu zì jǐ。
english_paragraphs: There is a cup with water in it. If I asked you, “What is this?”

What would you say? If I poured out the water and asked you the same question, what would you say then? When a cup is full of water, people might say, “It’s water.” When it’s full of milk, they might say, “It’s milk.” Only when there’s nothing in the cup do people say, “Look, it’s a cup.”
We are much the same. When our hearts are filled with wealth, prejudice, and power, we are no longer ourselves. People often want to have many things, yet struggle to truly be themselves.
english_full:
There is a cup with water in it. If I asked you, “What is this?”

What would you say? If I poured out the water and asked you the same question, what would you say then? When a cup is full of water, people might say, “It’s water.” When it’s full of milk, they might say, “It’s milk.” Only when there’s nothing in the cup do people say, “Look, it’s a cup.”

We are much the same. When our hearts are filled with wealth, prejudice, and power, we are no longer ourselves. People often want to have many things, yet struggle to truly be themselves.
